import random, sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *

rng = random.Random(7)

# ---- scale: many prefixes across all forests, many puts/queries, 3 saves, 16 loads
N = 8192
fib = []
seen = set()
while len(fib) < N:
    L = rng.choice([rng.randint(0,16), rng.randint(17,64), rng.randint(65,128)])
    a = ref.mask(rng.getrandbits(128), L)
    if (a,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((a,L))
    fib.append((a, L, rng.randint(0,4194302)))
print('distinct front16', len({a>>112 for a,l,h in fib if 17<=l<=64}),
      'front64', len({a>>64 for a,l,h in fib if l>=65}))
queries = random_queries(rng, fib, 200)
t0=time.time()
ok, img = check_fib('scale8192', fib, queries, verbose=True)
print('elapsed', round(time.time()-t0,1), 'rows', sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']),
      'cells', sum(img['cells']), 'bitmaps', len(img['bitmaps']), 'ni', len(img['nexthops']),
      'fronts', len(img['front16']), len(img['front64']))
PYEOF
